title: Texas orders an audit before any new data center plugs in - TCR 08/04/26
description:
Texas ordered an audit of every data center seeking a grid connection and barred new approvals until it finishes, a French open-weight lab told Wired its revenue climbed roughly twentyfold as curbs on some Anthropic models reportedly accelerated demand, and DeepSeek's V4-Flash cut agent-token costs 50% amid Beijing's involution warnings.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-august-4-2026/

0:00 Open and framing
0:35 Texas freezes data-center grid approvals
3:46 Open-weight Europe's adoption moment
6:48 Leaked Flock police surveillance playbook
9:32 Cogent VR-1 ships to vetted firms only
12:37 Close

This episode covers the Texas grid-connection freeze and 65-gigawatt interconnection queue, a federal bill making hyperscalers pay their own interconnection costs, open-weight Europe's adoption surge and DeepSeek's price cut, a leaked Flock playbook coaching police to brief councils before public comment, Cogent's gated VR-1 cyber-reasoning model, and a skin-disease AI tuned to narrow diagnostic gaps across skin tones.

This edition's spine is a set of arrangements built to keep costs invisible or capability concentrated, now being dragged into daylight all at once. Texas courted the AI buildout, then on Monday required operators behind pending data-center requests to connect to the ERCOT grid to disclose water use, tax breaks, and ownership before capacity gets allocated, while a federal bill moves to price interconnection costs back onto the beneficiary instead of every household's bill. Restrictions on some of Anthropic's most capable systems reportedly accelerated European enterprises' adoption of open-weight models they can run themselves, with one French lab's revenue up twentyfold and DeepSeek halving token costs on Monday. A leaked Flock guide shows a surveillance vendor scripting the answer before residents can object, even as the cost of independent auditing keeps falling. Cogent shipped a genuinely defensive cyber-reasoning model but rationed it to the best-defended buyers, while pairing it with a model-agnostic containment runtime any organization can run. And a skin-disease model showed the amount a system explains is now a measurable, tunable variable that can narrow diagnostic gaps across skin tones.
